text_zh: 「汝尚未择其道——既非铭刻之严，亦非熔变之诺。引擎静候，铅字默然。」
text_en: "Thou hast chosen neither path—neither the graven stern nor the molten vow. The Engine waits; the type lies silent."

text_zh: 「以铅屑甄别为始，以收容经卷为终——汝之手将废字归其位，令异文伏于版中。」
text_en: "From lead-shard sorting to containment scrolls complete—thy hands shall order wayward letters, bind anomalies to the page."

text_zh: 「熔蜡润其骨，重铸破其形——汝将伴异文共舞，任铭文组于坩埚中新生。」
text_en: "Molten unguent flows through bone, reforging breaks all form—thou shalt dance with anomalies, let inscriptions be reborn in the crucible."

text_zh:
ORDER-NULL · 消耗品
分级: 标准征用 / Standard Conscription

入会条件: 无。按§4.2自动补充。
执勤描述: 标准收容铭刻。无特殊授权。
失联率: 基准水平。
备注: D-████编号人员默认分类。条例要求维持最低编制███名。补充来源████████。表单F-001按需签领基础圣器。
text_en:
ORDER-NULL · Expendable
Classification: Standard Conscription

Entry Requirements: None. Auto-replenished per §4.2.
Duty Description: Standard containment inscription. No special clearance.
Loss Rate: Baseline.
Notes: Default classification for D-████ personnel. Standing orders require minimum complement of ███. Replacement sources ████████. Basic artifacts requisitioned via Form F-001 as needed.

text_zh:
ORDER-CLAVI · 铭刻誓门见习
分级: 受限征用 / Restricted Conscription

入会条件: 铅屑甄别测试合格。展现废铅分拣天赋。
执勤描述: 手工造册圣字钉。构筑收容经卷。精密铭刻作业。
神学立场: 形不可变。引擎律条为绝对。
对引擎态度: 敬畏并锁死其变化。经卷一旦完成，永不更改。
失联率: 低于基准。工艺精神降低意外率。
text_en:
ORDER-CLAVI · Novice Scribe of the Graven
Classification: Restricted Conscription

Entry Requirements: Passed lead-shaving sorting examination. Demonstrated scrap-sorting aptitude.
Duty Description: Manual cataloguing of sacred slugs. Construction of containment codices. Precision inscription work.
Theological Position: Form immutable. Engine statutes absolute.
Engine Doctrine: Reverent constraint of its permutations. Once codex complete, never altered.
Loss Rate: Below baseline. Craftsman discipline reduces incident frequency.

text_zh:
ORDER-FUSUM · 熔变誓门潜修
分级: 监管征用 / Supervised Conscription

入会条件: 耐受熔蜡接触。通过变形适应性评估。
执勤描述: 铭文组熔铸重塑。处理不定形收容物。适应性铭刻。
神学立场: 顺应引擎自然变化。拒绝强制锁定。
对引擎态度: 视其为活体过程，非死物。每次重铸皆为新生。
失联率: 波动。熔铸期间偶有预期外结果。持有者报告'感知铅的呼吸'。
text_en:
ORDER-FUSUM · Acolyte of the Molten Verse
Classification: Supervised Conscription

Entry Requirements: Molten unguent tolerance verified. Passed metamorphic adaptation assessment.
Duty Description: Inscription reforging operations. Handling of protean containment subjects. Adaptive inscription work.
Theological Position: Accommodate Engine's natural flux. Reject forced stabilization.
Engine Doctrine: Regard as living process, not artifact. Each reforging constitutes rebirth.
Loss Rate: Variable. Occasional unexpected outcomes during molten phases. Subjects report 'sensing lead's breath'.
